INSERT INTO order_item_set_components ( order_item_id, component_menu_id, component_menu_name ) SELECT #{orderItemId}, component.menu_id, component.menu_name FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = #{menuId}
